finding.summary: Table-cell rendering lowercases an enum string for every aligned cell.
finding.explanation: The nested table rendering loop calls ToString() and then ToLowerInvariant() on TableColumnAlignment for each aligned cell, creating two intermediate strings on a render path. A direct mapping to the required CSS token avoids the chained allocations.
